_comment_process: node directly on Nitro's server entrypoint, not `node_modules/.bin/nuxt`.
Same rule the other four configs state: pm2's pid IS the process. A .bin shim is a
/bin/sh script, so pm2 would supervise a shell and every signal would have to survive
a hop it cannot see past.
Lowest stakes of the set — the docs site holds no locks, no money and no database
connection, and a hard kill drops in-flight page renders and nothing else. It is
written the same way anyway so there is one idiom here, not two.

ROUTES: this app owns the whole of twominutebilling.com. `/` is the product landing
page (app/pages/index.vue) and the documentation lives under `/help`, which comes from
the content living in content/help/ — NOT from a baseURL. So the reverse proxy passes
every path through unchanged; it must not rewrite or strip anything.
Do not run `nuxt dev` against this checkout while building: the dev server holds the
Nuxt Content SQLite database and the build fails with `database is locked`.
